page.overview:
What is Space weapon?

Space weapons were stationary weapons designed to be mounted on starships, especially warships. Short-range craft like starfighters were most commonly fitted with laser cannons, while larger vessels like capital ships typically bristled with more powerful weaponry such as turbolaser and ion cannons.
